tech_stack.architecture: Mainframe batch (z/OS) with EC2 file gateway

findings.title: No API Interface — Batch File Exchange Only
findings.description: The application exposes no REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface. All integration is via fixed-width flat files transferred over plaintext FTP between the z/OS mainframe and an EC2 gateway.
findings.gap: No machine-callable API exists. Integration requires direct file-system access to mainframe datasets or FTP file pickup on the EC2 gateway.
findings.recommendation: Design a REST API wrapper exposing payroll operations as documented endpoints with OpenAPI specification.

findings.title: No Idempotency Controls on Write Operations
findings.description: The batch payroll process writes output sequentially with no idempotency controls. Re-execution produces duplicate output via new GDG generation.
findings.gap: No idempotency keys, no deduplication checks, no conditional write logic.
findings.recommendation: Add a pay-period/cycle-number check to prevent duplicate execution for the same pay period.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND batch writes have no idempotency protection.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system performs write operations (payroll output generation, FTP transfer) that would produce duplicates if triggered multiple times for the same pay period.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: No machine identity authentication exists. The only credential is a hardcoded plaintext FTP username/password in JCL with no caller attribution.
findings.gap: No mechanism for an agent to authenticate with a unique, attributable machine identity.
findings.recommendation: Deploy centralized identity provider with per-agent service accounts. Replace FTP with SFTP using IAM-attributed credentials.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. No CloudTrail, no immutable log storage, no principal attribution for write operations.
findings.gap: Write operations leave no tamper-evident audit trail. Cannot prove compliance or conduct forensics.
findings.recommendation: Enable CloudTrail for EC2 gateway. Implement structured audit logging with caller identity. Store logs in S3 with Object Lock.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents executing payroll operations must have full audit attribution for compliance (SOX, financial controls).

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback Capability
findings.description: No compensation or rollback capability exists. Sequential batch processing with no checkpoint/restart logic.
findings.gap: No saga pattern, no compensating transactions, no undo endpoints, no checkpoint/restart.
findings.recommendation: Implement checkpoint/restart logic and multi-step compensation for the batch workflow.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no rollback exists for multi-step batch operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The batch performs sequential write operations (calculate, write file, FTP transfer) that cannot be undone if a step fails mid-sequence.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Unscoped in Agent-Facing Output
findings.description: System processes SSNs and bank accounts. All sensitive data output unscoped in flat files. No access control differentiation.
findings.gap: B1: Sensitive fields in output without filtering. B2: No access differentiation. B3: No classification metadata.
findings.recommendation: Implement field-level filtering. Create separately-authorized endpoints for sensitive data access.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fires — sensitive fields (SSN, bank accounts) output unscoped.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Agent-facing output contains SSN and bank account numbers without any field-level filtering or scoping. B1 fires at BLOCKER severity under write-enabled scope.

b1.reasoning: EMP-SSN and EMP-ACCT included in unfiltered output records accessible via FTP.

b2.reasoning: Single FTP credential grants access to all data — no scope differentiation.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata exists.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls — Plaintext FTP of PII
findings.description: SSNs and bank accounts transmitted via plaintext FTP to EC2 with no encryption in transit, no residency controls, no sovereignty policies.
findings.gap: No data residency enforcement, no encryption in transit, no cross-region movement controls.
findings.recommendation: Replace FTP with SFTP or AWS Transfer Family. Implement region-pinning controls and data classification policies.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND PII transmitted without encryption or residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: SSN and bank account data transmitted via plaintext FTP — no technical controls prevent cross-region data movement to LLM providers.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions Model
findings.description: No authorization model supports scoped permissions. Single shared FTP credential grants unrestricted access.
findings.gap: No mechanism to scope agent permissions to specific resources or actions.
findings.recommendation: Implement IAM roles with least-privilege policies for any agent-facing surface.

compensating_controls: Restrict network access via security groups
Implement API layer with IAM scoped permissions

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization exists. No differentiation between read/write/delete permissions.
findings.gap: No ABAC, no fine-grained RBAC, no permission matrices.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level authorization when building the API surface.

compensating_controls: API Gateway with method-level authorization
IAM policies with explicit action-level allow/deny

findings.title: No Identity Propagation or Delegation
findings.description: No identity propagation. No JWT, no OAuth flows, no caller context. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: No mechanism to propagate caller identity through operations.
findings.recommendation: Design token-based identity propagation into the API modernization plan.

compensating_controls: Log triggering identity externally
Implement token-based identity in new API wrapper

findings.title: Hardcoded Plaintext Credentials
findings.description: FTP credentials hardcoded in plaintext in JCL: username payroll, password PayR0ll2003!. No secrets management, no rotation.
findings.gap: Credentials embedded in source code. No Secrets Manager, no Vault, no rotation.
findings.recommendation: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager. Replace FTP with SFTP using IAM-based authentication.

compensating_controls: Move credentials to RACF or Secrets Manager
Restrict repository access

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend individual agent identities. Single shared credential with no per-agent revocation.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without disrupting all consumers.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-agent identities with individual revocation capability.

compensating_controls: Implement per-agent API keys in new API surface
Use IAM with per-agent roles

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No concurrency controls. Sequential file access with no locking. Concurrent execution produces duplicated/corrupted results.
findings.gap: No optimistic locking, no ETags, no version fields, no conflict detection.
findings.recommendation: Implement mutex/lock mechanism. Add optimistic locking in modernized API.

compensating_controls: CA-7 schedule prevents concurrent execution
Add lock file or semaphore mechanism

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configurations. FTP transfer has no timeout or retry on failure.
findings.gap: External dependency failure causes unhandled hang or crash.
findings.recommendation: Add timeout and retry logic for FTP transfer. Implement health-check validation before transfer.

compensating_controls: JCL COND CODE checks provide basic failure detection
Add JCL TIME parameter for execution timeout

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable limits on operations. Batch processes ALL employee records unconditionally with no maximum count or spend limits.
findings.gap: No per-agent transaction limits, no maximum records per run, no configurable blast radius.
findings.recommendation: Add configurable record count limits and dry-run mode for agent-initiated executions.

compensating_controls: Add record count validation that aborts above threshold
Implement dry-run mode

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs or Diagnostic Output
findings.description: No PII redaction capability. SSNs and bank accounts in working storage exposed in abend dumps. No log scrubbing or masking.
findings.gap: No log scrubbing, no PII masking. System abends expose PII in diagnostic output.
findings.recommendation: Implement PII masking in all logging and error output when building modernized interface.

compensating_controls: Restrict access to SYSOUT and dumps
Implement PII masking in new API/logging layer

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State for Write Operations
findings.description: No draft or pending state. Batch runs to completion immediately with no human review step.
findings.gap: All write operations immediately committed. No reviewable intermediate state.
findings.recommendation: Introduce two-phase execution: preview/summary for review, then commit after approval.

compensating_controls: Pre-validation summary for human review
Staging output area requiring manual promotion

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No configurable approval gates. CA-7 triggers automatically with no human confirmation required.
findings.gap: No approval mechanism for high-risk operations.
findings.recommendation: Add configurable approval gate for agent-initiated payroll runs using Step Functions with human approval task.

compensating_controls: Require manual CA-7 job release for agent-triggered runs
Implement approval workflow in new API layer

findings.title: No Async Support for Long-Running Batch (5-7 Hours)
findings.description: 5-7 hour batch with no async patterns — no job submission API, no polling, no callbacks.
findings.gap: No asynchronous operation support for a long-running process.
findings.recommendation: Implement job submission with status polling endpoint. Consider Step Functions for batch lifecycle.

compensating_controls: Monitor JCL job completion via z/OS events
Implement status file on EC2 gateway

findings.title: No Queryable State Interface
findings.description: No queryable interface. Employee and payroll state locked in DB2 and z/OS datasets with no API access.
findings.gap: Agent cannot inspect state before taking action.
findings.recommendation: Build read-only API for querying employee payroll state.

compensating_controls: Expose read-only query on EC2 gateway for recent output
Implement DB2 query API

findings.title: No Input Validation or Schema Enforcement
findings.description: No input validation at API boundary. COBOL reads fixed-format records without validation. Malformed records processed silently.
findings.gap: No validation, no schema enforcement, no structured error responses for invalid input.
findings.recommendation: Implement request validation with structured error responses in the new API. Add pre-execution data quality checks.

compensating_controls: Pre-processing validation of master file
Input validation in new API wrapper

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata in Output
findings.description: No timestamps in output records. No freshness signals. Agent cannot determine data currency.
findings.gap: No temporal metadata, no freshness indicators, no timezone handling.
findings.recommendation: Add processing timestamps and pay period dates to all output.

compensating_controls: Use GDG generation number as proxy temporal metadata
Add header/trailer record with timestamp

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning. Fixed-width format defined implicitly by COBOL with no formal schema, no versioning, no changelog.
findings.gap: No schema documentation, no versioning, no breaking change detection.
findings.recommendation: Document record layout formally. Add version identifier. Implement contract tests.

compensating_controls: Document current record layout as formal schema
Add header record with format version

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No dedicated sandbox. Changes validated in shared QA region only. No isolation for agent testing.
findings.gap: No isolated test environment for agent behavior validation.
findings.recommendation: Establish dedicated sandbox with synthetic payroll data (no real PII).

compensating_controls: Restrict agent testing to shared QA with monitoring
Create minimal test dataset

findings.title: Zero Automated Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests. README states 'No automated tests.' No test files, no CI pipeline.
findings.gap: Zero test coverage. No regression detection.
findings.recommendation: Create test baseline with golden file comparisons. Build automated tests.

compensating_controls: Document expected input/output pairs
Create basic test harness

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. DB2 v10 (end of support), z/OS datasets, and EC2 files store sensitive data unencrypted.
findings.gap: Sensitive data (SSN, bank accounts) stored without encryption. No KMS.
findings.recommendation: Encrypt data at rest: upgrade DB2, enable z/OS dataset encryption, ensure EC2 EBS uses KMS.

compensating_controls: Ensure EC2 EBS volume uses KMS encryption
Restrict physical access to mainframe

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No tracing or structured logging. Only unstructured JCL SYSOUT. No trace IDs, no correlation IDs.
findings.gap: Cannot reconstruct batch execution from logs.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry tracing and structured JSON logging in modernized system.

compensating_controls: Use JCL job number as basic correlation ID
Implement structured logging in new API layer

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — machine-readable spec is not applicable. System operates via batch file exchange.
findings.gap: No API surface exists to describe with a machine-readable spec.
findings.recommendation: Generate OpenAPI spec as part of the API modernization effort.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — structured error responses are not applicable. Batch signals failure via JCL return codes.
findings.gap: No API error responses exist.
findings.recommendation: Design structured error format as part of API modernization.

findings.title: Fixed-Width Flat File Response Format
findings.description: Output is fixed-width 120-byte flat file records requiring positional parsing with no self-describing schema.
findings.gap: Non-standard format not directly consumable by agents or LLMs.
findings.recommendation: Implement JSON serialization in the modernized API layer.

findings.title: No Event Emission Capability
findings.description: No event emission. No webhooks, no SNS/EventBridge, no Kafka. State changes not signaled.
findings.gap: State changes invisible to downstream consumers.
findings.recommendation: Publish events to EventBridge for payroll completion when modernizing.

findings.title: No API-Layer Rate Limiting
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — API-layer rate limiting is not applicable. Batch scheduled by CA-7.
findings.gap: No API surface to apply rate limiting.
findings.recommendation: Include API Gateway throttling when building agent-facing interface.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — alerting on API error rates is not applicable. No CloudWatch alarms exist.
findings.gap: No alerting for batch failures or performance degradation.
findings.recommendation: Configure alerting when building the API surface.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC and no auth surface — IaC governance for agent-facing surface not applicable. No IaC exists.
findings.gap: No IaC. Infrastructure managed manually.
findings.recommendation: Define infrastructure as code when building agent-facing components.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — API contract testing not applicable. No CI/CD pipeline exists.
findings.gap: No automated build or deployment process.
findings.recommendation: Establish CI/CD pipeline with contract tests as part of modernization.

findings.title: No Deployment Rollback Capability
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — deployment rollback not applicable. No deployment pipeline. Manual mainframe recompilation required.
findings.gap: No automated rollback mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Include rollback capability in modernization architecture.

findings.title: No Data Quality Metrics
findings.description: No data quality metrics or monitoring. Tax tables updated manually with no completeness tracking.
findings.gap: No data quality awareness. Stale data processed silently.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality checks before batch execution.

findings.title: Legacy Abbreviated Field Names
findings.description: Field names use abbreviated mainframe conventions: EMP-RATE, WS-FICA, EMP-SSN. Partially interpretable but require domain knowledge.
findings.gap: No data dictionary mapping legacy codes to semantic names.
findings.recommendation: Create data dictionary for agent tool definitions.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog. Only implicit schema in COBOL FD section serves as documentation.
findings.gap: No metadata layer describing data semantics.
findings.recommendation: Create metadata catalog. Consider AWS Glue Data Catalog for modernized layer.

evaluations.title: Rate Limit Documentation and Headers
evaluations.reason: No API/HTTP surface exists — informational signal, no finding emitted. Suppressed via Informational-Absence Suppression.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: System emits no metrics or telemetry of any kind — informational signal, no finding emitted. Suppressed via Informational-Absence Suppression.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service priority not specified as P0 and critical path status not confirmed.

evaluations.title: Selective Query Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no list/query endpoints exist (batch-only system with no API surface).

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Establish API surface, machine identity, audit logging, data scoping, and encryption in transit. This is foundational — no agent integration can proceed until these are addressed.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY (identity propagation, blast radius limits) and RISK-QUALITY findings. Build out observability, schema documentation, async patterns, and infrastructure governance.
Address quality improvements: automated testing, response format modernization, event emission, data quality metrics, data catalog, and field naming improvements.

recommended_actions.action: Build REST API wrapper with OpenAPI specification
recommended_actions.rationale: No agent integration is possible without a machine-callable API. This is the foundational dependency for all other remediation.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity provider with per-agent credentials
recommended_actions.rationale: Machine identity is the prerequisite for audit logging, scoped permissions, and agent suspension — all currently missing.

recommended_actions.action: Replace plaintext FTP with encrypted transfer (SFTP/AWS Transfer Family)
recommended_actions.rationale: SSN and bank account data transmitted in cleartext is a compliance violation. Encrypted transfer with IAM credentials addresses both data residency and credential management.

recommended_actions.action: Implement audit logging with CloudTrail and immutable storage
recommended_actions.rationale: Write-enabled agent operations on financial data require immutable audit trails for SOX compliance.

recommended_actions.action: Implement data scoping and field-level access controls
recommended_actions.rationale: Agent-facing responses must exclude SSN and bank account fields unless explicitly authorized through separate scoped endpoints.
